subject: check-branch-collision refuses every push from a card worktree, because it reads the checked-out branch and finds Hydrostat's own claim ref
activeForm: Teaching check-branch-collision about pushed refs and Hydrostat claims

origin.evidence: cd ~/worktrees/sentiment-analyzer-gsk/card-<id> && git push --dry-run origin HEAD:refs/heads/some-other-branch  # prints ORPHAN BRANCH DETECTED for card-<id>

work_items: Card #22: make check-branch-collision judge the refs being pushed, not the checked-out branch

description: Found by card #17 on 2026-10-14. scripts/check-branch-collision.sh (pre-push stage) takes BRANCH from git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD and refuses when origin has that branch with no PR. In a card worktree the checked-out branch is card-<id>, and origin/card-<id> always exists as Hydrostat's claim ref with no PR, so every push from a card worktree is refused as an orphan, including a refspec push to a different remote branch (git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/card-17-frontend-ci). The hook never reads the pushed refs, which git supplies on the pre-push hook's stdin. Card #17 worked around it with a temporary worktree checked out on the target branch name. Fix: read local_ref remote_ref pairs from stdin and check each remote_ref; treat refs/heads/card-<n> claim refs as known.
